note: Set P is four nacreous/pearl-cloud dusk-or-night poems that all stress rarity and being unseen, so the subject and image repeat and only the closing angle shifts. Set Q is four lenticular-over-ridge poems with the same wind-and-stillness image, but Q1 adds a camera-lens angle and snow, Q2 a colour shift from pearl to gray, and Q4 a late-autumn setting, so it varies slightly more, though Q1, Q3 and Q4 are close to interchangeable.
